title: AI Agents vs Physical AI - Understanding the Key Differences
description: The artificial intelligence landscape encompasses diverse system types with fundamentally different characteristics. Two categories receiving significant attention are AI agents operating in digital environments and Physical AI systems that interact with the real world. Understanding the distinctions between these categories is essential for researchers, developers, and students seeking to navigate this rapidly evolving field.
